acceptanceCriteria.description: Given an implementation-result whose filesChanged touch a module the task's targetModule may not depend on, When the supervisor ingests it, Then the violation is reported and the step does not pass validation.

Given a boundary violation, When validation.json is written, Then the entry is distinguishable from a schema error — by its path, its message, or an explicit field — so a reader can tell an architectural failure from a malformed output.
Given an implementation-result that respects the rules, When it is ingested, Then no boundary error is produced and the step proceeds exactly as before.
Given a workspace with no dependency-rules.json, When ingest runs, Then boundary checking is skipped without error, so the feature is additive for projects that have not configured it.
